title: CCA prospective payable-relief and compensation-timing validation
description: Software, aggregate results, paper sources, and verification workflows for frozen-origin CCA validation across every quarter of 2022 and 2023, weekly-to-annual horizons, and compensation-timing outcomes. Exact row-level reproduction requires authorized data access.
notes: The software and aggregate release are public. Row-level transaction data remain subject to the dataset license and privacy controls described in DATA_LICENSE.md.
